name: The Mark of Quality
summary: At Feathermoon Stronghold, Pratt McGrubben seeks ten thick yeti hides and offers a choice of leather goods.

sections.title: Pratt's Philosophy
sections.body: Pratt McGrubben, a leatherworker at Feathermoon Stronghold, insists on the finest work. In search of fine materials, he found thick yeti hides. Yetis are native to Feralas, and many live around Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast.

sections.title: The Offer
sections.body: Bring Pratt a stack of ten hides at Feathermoon Stronghold. In return, you may choose one of the leather goods he has crafted.

sections.title: Pratt's Thoughts on the Hides
sections.body: Pratt McGrubben asks whether you felt the hides’ texture. Properly treated, they could prove tougher than iron, and few people know of them. Pratt knows many treating solutions. He hopes to shape the hides into pieces worthy of a true mark of quality.

faq.q: Who is asking for the hides?
aliases: who gives the mark of quality
faq.answer: Pratt McGrubben, the leatherworker at Feathermoon Stronghold, asks for the hides.

faq.q: Where can the yetis be found?
faq.answer: Around Feral Scar Vale, just inland of the Forgotten Coast, where many of Feralas's native yetis live.

faq.q: How many hides does Pratt want?
faq.answer: Pratt wants ten hides in one stack.

faq.q: What do I get for the hides?
faq.answer: Pratt offers your choice of one of the leather goods he has crafted in exchange for the stack.
